mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_attachments WHERE (status='STAGED' AND expires_at<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR status='EXPIRED' ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_attachments SET status='EXPIRED' WHERE id=#{id} AND ((status='STAGED' AND expires_at<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR status='EXPIRED')
UPDATE repair_attachments SET status='DELETED' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='EXPIRED'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repair_attachments WHERE storage_backend='LOCAL' AND object_key=#{key})
SELECT * FROM repair_attachments WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_attachments SET status='BOUND',ticket_id=#{ticketId},bound_event_id=#{eventId} WHERE id=#{id} AND uploader_id=#{actor} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND status='STAGED' AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (ticket_id IS NULL OR ticket_id=#{ticketId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_attachments WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND status='BOUND' AND purpose IN ('FAULT','WORK_RECORD','RESULT') AND bound_event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT * FROM repair_attachments WHERE purchase_order_id=#{orderId} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND status='BOUND' AND bound_event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY created_at,id
